reason: I'd try the free version, but I wouldn't pay. WhatsApp with my family and my own memory already work, and I don't want one more subscription when I'm watching every dirham.
objection: I throw out some vegetables, but that's maybe a few dirhams a week. Scanning receipts and paying every month to save that doesn't add up, and I'd probably stop using it after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: If the free version were enough to catch what's about to expire, or if Plus were a one-time payment of a few dollars with no recurring charge.
